rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible"): The record metadata specifies Tsumbu H.D., Cammaerts D., Adant I., Nzuzi F.L., and Deliège J.-F. (2022), "Water true-cost to manage social contestability? Users' perceptions about community-managed water standpipes networks in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo" (DOI: 10.5004/dwt.2022.28619). However, the retrieved 278-page PDF is an entirely different publication: the 2014 IWA Publishing edited book "Community Based Water Management and Social Capital" edited by Kiyoshi Kobayashi, Ibnu Syabri, Ismu Rini Dwi Ari, and Hayeong Jeong (ISBN 9781780405452), comprising 15 chapters on collective action theory and Indonesian water management case studies. Because the target study's full text is not accessible in the provided document and guessing from the title is prohibited, both decision and plain_criterion2_decision are set to cannot_tell with exclusion_code NONE.
